blocks.title: P0 · Use the app without carrying the SSD
blocks.evidence: Implemented migration; delivery failed; independence unverified. a58c883 moves app installs local; 0cc6f1c migrates data. Prior startup investigation found .2 started in 3.226 seconds but inherited the wrong data root, while the installer waited for health elsewhere and rolled back.
blocks.next: The existing startup owner must fix the updater used by the running installation, then verify app + effective data root + health acknowledgement locally. Merely replacing the new bundle or increasing the timeout is insufficient. Only a subsequent SSD-independent launch establishes the user’s outcome.

blocks.title: P1 · Separate Claude/Codex sidebar settings
blocks.evidence: Implemented, not successfully installed. User approved this on 27 October 19:52. dd0316d, Settings.tsx around 480: Claude model and subagents model; Codex model; shared reasoning effort separately. No independent effort setting per engine was requested or implemented.
blocks.next: Deliver this existing fix with the corrected install, then inspect the actual bot-settings sidebar. No redesign is justified by current evidence.

blocks.title: P1 · Grouped task sidebar
blocks.evidence: Implemented and historically delivered; current visual behavior unverified. 8e4a85d, merged ee6adfe; App’s .3 install acknowledgement at archive line 10874 explicitly includes grouped tasks and hover timeline. RightPanel.tsx:310 and task-sidebar-grouped.test.ts define foldable Needs you / Running / Done, Now→Next and hover timeline.
blocks.next: If this is the sidebar the user means, establish the exact failing interaction after the installation issue is resolved. Do not label its problem as an uninstalled .2 feature.

blocks.title: P1 · Move all 23 cards to the component kit
blocks.evidence: Not completed in the available record. Kit 09ff3cd/bba061d and Maintainer editor entry a685b19 (merge ca2f83d) exist. Archive lines 11121–11123 explicitly leave the 23-card migration pending; no later completion evidence was found in the relevant archive/memory.
blocks.next: Verify the real App-created Maintainer entry, then have its existing owner finish and account for all 23 cards. Source library completion does not prove user-card migration.

blocks.title: P2 · Faster startup and lower CPU
blocks.evidence: Implemented in .1 lineage; benefit not measured after delivery. History window 5e923a6, state deltas aa5efea/4b5b3eb, watches/cache de08eba, idle ticker 8ce98b3, startup log d23b395. The earlier CPU samples included background work and are not pure idle baselines.
blocks.next: After stable local installation, compare like-for-like startup and idle/workload CPU. Unselected-bot history deferral remains explicitly deferred in memory, not a proven necessary next optimization. Do not infer a Rust rewrite requirement.

blocks.title: P2 · Update without restarting
blocks.evidence: Implemented; real-use acceptance pending. Persistent renderer loader 84ced25, chat reload 958577c, core swap 6c9c96d, install selection 70a26cc. Memory says live renderer profile was not enabled and lists Cmd+R, Alt+Cmd+R, next hot install and real resume as unverified.
blocks.next: Reuse existing test evidence; perform only the missing live scenarios after the installation baseline is stable, with user focus preserved. Kernel changes still require restart by design.

blocks.title: Later · Windows / Linux
blocks.evidence: Targets configured; native delivery and runtime unverified. desktop/README.md:1087 records no Windows/Linux build or execution. Memory records missing Windows environment.
blocks.next: Keep separate from the immediate macOS delivery gap; native platform validation needs its own environment and authorization.

sections.title: 不要把已完成工作重新列成新功能

blocks.text: Whiteboard B 已選定與實作（9df6f60），截圖遺漏已修正（0ffa620）；輸入所有權／overlay 修正 cf46473、d1a4ec8 早於使用者確認 .7 正常。舊 README spike/E3 記錄不足以證明目前輸入回歸。Image paste/drop（2094e39）、dropdown settings、editor entry 已有實作；部分 live checks 仍待完成，不能推論整套 2.x 尚未實作。
內容以版本化 JSON 提供；既有 React 19 + React DOM 在產生時渲染共用元件，Zod 驗證缺欄、未知欄位與表格列寬。HTML 包含全部樣式、沒有 runtime、CDN 或圖片。下一份報告只需換資料；不需重寫 HTML/CSS。

blocks.caption: 固定規格與選用內容
rows: subtitle、段落、清單、狀態發現、表格、證據、下一步、限制
系統字型、8px 間距節奏、窄螢幕重排、深淺色、列印樣式。

blocks.text: 產生方式：node desktop/scripts/report.mjs desktop/reports/examples/project-status-20261028.json /完整路徑/.bot/artifacts/report.html。把輸出的 file:// Markdown 連結放進回覆，既有 PagePreview 會自動產生卡片；2.x 透過 botling-card://preview 載入。瀏覽器列印可使用 print CSS；App 內是否提供列印入口依宿主功能，不宣稱新增 PDF 匯出。
